summary: Emit canonical agent identities in mission presentation and admit canonical mission work actors

replay.detail: Historical rows remain unchanged; presentation canonicalizes legacy slash-qualified agent identities on read. Re-parsing stored declarations preserves historical host-relative qualification and malformed assignee normalization rather than rejecting them.

schema.detail: The strict client AgentId schema and database schema are unchanged.

rules.detail: Mission assignees, run-start actors and work actions canonicalize slash-qualified agent identities. Work eligibility, reads, renewal, successor lookup and capacity accounting compare canonical identities; malformed work actors are rejected.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version compatible expansion: legacy assignees and candidates keep their stored spelling for new lease ownership, allowing older members to renew, release and complete work; canonical assignments write canonical owners. Reads and capacity compare canonical identities. LIVE-MIGRATION BRIDGE arn:lmig:fractal:2026-11-07-agent-actor-ownership contracts only after every fleet member runs canonical comparisons, when a later change migrates stored rows and removes the exception.

downtime.detail: No data migration or coordinated client rollout is required.

recovery.detail: Lease fencing remains unchanged. Signed legacy work ownership can arrive before its target row during cold import; projection checks canonical eligibility and records a defect without taking the lease if the target selector does not match.
